name: ClearView (Unified) Renderer
definition: A 3-pass WebGL2 renderer using Parallel Prefix List (PPLL) for unstructured mesh rendering, consisting of Clear, Gather, and Resolve passes.
summary: ClearView (Unified) Renderer is a WebGL2 renderer for hexahedral meshes that bypasses SSBO limits by encoding data in textures and using atomic operations for depth-sorted alpha blending.
